title: Extremism / Hate Group / High-Control Source Registry

source_classes.use: legal status, prosecutions, organizational history and court-established facts
group histories, ideology, public activity and monitoring classifications; designation must be attributed rather than treated as universal law
definitions, movement history, high-control dynamics, radicalization and comparative analysis
self-description, doctrine, organizational claims and direct statements; claims require independent contextualization

safety_boundary: Do not store private addresses, private contact information, member identity lists, weapons inventories, tactical instructions or instructions that would facilitate violence. Public geographic information should normally stop at country/state/region or a well-known public headquarters when relevant to historical identification.
